title: Shielded Ledger
tagline: Shielded Ledger is a confidential token launchpad with minting functionality.
description:
Tracking where the payment is happening and for how much the amount is becoming a problem with each passing day. Shielded Ledger let users mint confidential tokens which they can use to pay or transfer from one account to another. We have also integrated stealth addresses based on ERC-5564. We are using zero knowledge proofs to proof that a transaction has happened from launching/minting token.
For now the platform only supports minting functionality, but we are working to bring in transfer, burning and converting back to normal token functionality. Also we are researching to implement dark pools in order to let people use Shielded Ledger as a full-fledged DeFi Application.
how_its_made: This project uses ERC 5564, Zero Knowledge Proofs (Circom), Smart Contracts (Solidity), Nextjs for frontend. We integrated 3 circuits which are deposit, withdraw and transfer with main contract which is zkERC20.sol which basically helps in minting zk tokens. Apart from that we have a collateral manager which let's people provide existing tokens as collateral with 1:1 ratio. So if MON price $1, zkMON will also have the same price. All the transactions happens through commitments
